findings.rule: Canonical lowest shared owner; complete producer propagation; preserve unrelated work.
findings.evidence: Incoming Buffer module adds admission_error but omits Root capacity/stride declarations and exports. Root ScalpTextureLayout and Hair rod/collision producers consume BufferElementStride/BufferElementCount; SortScratch.ensure returns BufferCapacityChange. Blind replacement disconnects existing canonical owners.
findings.repair: Compose the import/reexport/module union: retain capacity and stride exactly; add admission_error and intended MappingExtent/MappingRequest/Readback crate-GPU visibility. Copy new admission_error.rs; do not create another count/stride/capacity owner or adapter.
findings.acceptance: Current Root callers resolve exact original types; only the three old local rejection roots change representation; all buffer allocation/write/prefix/readback bodies retain byte/zero/device/poll contracts.

findings.rule: Apply only relevant reductions; never raise or resurrect ceilings.
findings.evidence: Root has 2059 records (208 files,482 functions,1369 findings), incoming 2055 (207,479,1369). Incoming removes seven exact old native records but adds three already removed in Root: Hair gpu/sim.rs650, DualContouringDefinition::new442, MarchingCubesDefinition::new224. Its 2055-survivor statement is relative to donor baseline, not current Root.
findings.repair: Remove only seven exact native records from current Root; preserve all other current Root records unchanged, including its three preexisting reductions. No whole incoming baseline replacement.
findings.acceptance: Result2052 records (206 files,477 functions,1369 findings), seven removals/no additions/no ceiling changes against this Root; final authoritative hosted baseline export still required.

findings.rule: Closed local error classifications have typed owning errors; native source causes remain source errors.
findings.evidence: These actual constructors/conversions/reads reject known local states with static strings or anyhow prose while adjacent native buffer/view/pass errors already carry closed roles. For example unsupported PixelFormat conversion is a public static-str error, and invalid native size/unsupported read format cannot be downcast by semantic role.
findings.repair: Introduce/reuse focused texture-format, existing size-admission and image-conversion error roles with payloads; convert into existing heterogeneous anyhow boundary as needed. Preserve Display text/error precedence and direct Naga/wgpu/IO error chains. Inventory every actual caller before changing native extent APIs. No new float policy, size type, clamp, exact-byte admission or broad resource framework.
findings.acceptance: All enumerated existing guards return inspectable named roles with relevant original dimensions/format. 3D negative/zero max(1) policy, 2D/cube casts and min/max order, uploads trailing-byte behavior, and Image::from_pixels acceptance remain unchanged. No SDK failure is replaced by message-only cause.

findings.rule: Closed supported roles in API types; named semantic records; no compatibility adapters.
findings.evidence: TextureBinaryOp::execute takes three GpuResource values but rejects every non-Texture2d variant with three prose errors. Only two actual callers already own Texture2d references. Cache key is positional input-A/input-B/output descriptor triple.
findings.repair: Change direct execute signature to Texture2d references, migrate its two callers directly, remove impossible variant branches and duplicate wrapping. Replace tuple cache key with named descriptor record. No general-resource overload, temporary primitive adapter, or second implementation.
findings.acceptance: Native generated math, input ordering, existing amount float behavior, format descriptors, effective validation policy and device/source cache identity unchanged; wrong dimensionality unrepresentable through this operation.

findings.rule: Reuse canonical shared numerical owner; distinguish native shader boundary from Rust calculation.
findings.evidence: Cubemap conversion repeats scalar sRGB decoding twice despite direct Color dependency. Color also exposes enabled wgsl_transfer_functions; converter repeats linear_to_srgb. Canonical WGSL uses max(linear,0) in pow branch; local converter omits it. Existing GPU Cargo enables Color wgpu feature.
findings.repair: Reuse Color scalar srgb_to_linear for cubemap Rust branches, retaining clamp/truncation, alpha and BGRA swaps. Reconcile WGSL owner and negative/nonfinite branch semantics explicitly before using shared emitted transfer source; no second independently maintained transfer formula. Do not substitute Image::packed_for, whose no-transfer byte contract differs.
findings.acceptance: Actual positive RGB/encoded bytes and alpha policies preserved; incomplete input RGBA groups retain old handling; native shader workgroup/dispatch/layout stays exact except intentional shared function composition; source proof accounts for finite-negative/nonfinite select behavior and shared owner dependency.

findings.rule: Trait error parameters explicit; cohesive ordinary same-error APIs use owning alias.
findings.evidence: TextureValue TryFrom return is TextureValueResult<Self> although trait sets Self::Error. StagedResults prefix/status are cohesive same-StagingError ordinary methods with explicit repeated Result.
findings.repair: TryFrom uses Result<Self,Self::Error>; retain TextureValueResult only for actual ordinary APIs. Add/use StagingResult<T> for prefix/status, preserving GenerateError-returning ArmorGpu methods as their distinct family.
findings.acceptance: Signature spelling/declaration only; no error widening/source change, new helper, fixture or assertion.

findings.rule: Imports/reexports before modules; structs before enums; derive equivalent traits when contracts/bounds permit.
findings.evidence: Three modules put mod before imports/reexports; texture fixture Method enum precedes structs. PassParameters manual Default is exactly empty IndexMap through new, without extra generic constraints.
findings.repair: Move complete declaration/attribute/doc blocks into repository order, preserving cfg and visibility; derive Default on PassParameters and keep new behavior equivalent. Fixture changes limited to ordering existing blocks.
findings.acceptance: Exact inverse whole-block source comparison; no fixture case/helper/assertion creation. Do not derive Texture2d/3d/Cube Default: pinned wgpu TextureUsages lacks Default. Do not derive generic ComputeSourceCache Default if it adds Parameters/Value bounds. GPU has no direct thiserror dependency; manual Error impls are not silently derivable through a transitive dependency.

findings.rule: Root AGENTS: iteration observations/verdicts/transcripts in ignored output; durable guides describe usage/contracts.
findings.evidence: Final guide paragraph records earlier software Vulkan observations and current acceptance-run workflow.
findings.repair: Keep durable runtime scope and documented limits, retain actual observations in ignored local report rather than durable guide history.
findings.acceptance: No claimed hardware/browser/runtime validation inferred from this review or old run; useful API documentation retained.
